title: AI diabetic retinopathy assessment raises referral uptake in a randomized trial in Rwanda
summary: In a randomized trial of 275 participants, referral adherence was 51.5% (70/136) with AI assessment versus 39.6% (55/139) without (P=0.048). The outcome is behavioural uptake rather than diagnostic accuracy, and the P value is borderline.
ai_technology: AI diabetic retinopathy grading giving immediate referral feedback
organization: Rwanda International Institute of Ophthalmology, Kigali; Orbis International

evidence.unknown: AI used as screening tool; finding is behavioural uptake; borderline P; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AI diabetic retinopathy grading gives immediate referral feedback
